Samyaktvakaumudī
a collection of stories (in prose mixed with verse) relating to Arhaddāsa an. his several wives.
1st Recension
collection is narrated by Sukastin to King Samprati in about 1481 Granthas.
2nd Recension
collection is narrated by Gautama to King Śreṇika in about 1500 Granthas. The copies differ a. great deal from one another.
See Strassburg Dig. p. 15.

Samyaktvakaumudī
